setup: Pulley at its lowest, ankle cuff on
Cuff on the leg further from the stack
Step out until the cable is taut
execution: Lift the leg out to the side
Lead with the heel, toes forward
Keep your body tall and still
faults: Don't lean away to lift higher

notes: Hold the frame firmly; the standing leg balances you through the set.
Lift only as high as you can without leaning or twisting; the range is small.
The stack number is the selector reading; cable setups differ between gyms.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
Pain in the hip of the standing leg

guideBrief.cameraNote: Front view at hip height so the leg moving out to the side and the still, upright trunk are clear. Cable runs from a low pulley at the figure's side to the far ankle.

keyPositions.label: Start
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall side-on to the stack, near hand on the frame. Working leg (the one further from the stack) crossed slightly in front of the standing leg, cable taut.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Working leg lifted out to the side, knee straight, toes forward. Trunk still upright, hips level.

ikHints: Cable line runs from the pulley to the ankle
